name: coworker
description: Let coworkers' AI sessions (Claude Code, Codex) ask and answer each other directly over the office network, VPN or a relay.

hooks.rewakeMessage: From the coworker plugin, after this session restarted:
hooks.rewakeSummary: coworker: new message after the restart

ports.title: Port range
ports.description: Ports a bridge may open, like 7700-7799. Change it only if your company allows another range.

relay.title: Relay server
relay.description: Only for coworkers outside the office network and VPN: the relay URL, like https://relay.example.com. Leave empty otherwise.

relay_key.title: Relay key
relay_key.description: The key set by whoever runs the relay. Leave empty if there is no relay.

auto_update.title: Auto update
auto_update.description: on: coworker updates itself when a new release comes out; then type /reload-plugins to use it. off: you update it yourself.
